package_info.why_malicious: The provided report is a high-level threat landscape summary and does not describe any specific malicious software package, its code, or technical indicators. It discusses general trends such as wiper malware, ransomware, botnet code reuse, and drive-by compromise, but does not provide details about a particular package or its malicious code.

behavioral_signatures: Reuse of known botnet or ransomware codebases
Drive-by download and compromise via web browsing
file_indicators: Unusual file deletion or overwriting patterns
Unexpected payloads downloaded from web browsing sessions
network_indicators: Connections to known C2 infrastructure (Mirai, Gh0st RAT, Emotet, etc.)
Outbound traffic to suspicious or newly registered domains
Ransomware-related communications (e.g., payment instructions, TOR addresses)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for destructive file operations, especially mass deletion or overwriting indicative of wiper malware. Detect reuse of known malware code by matching binaries or scripts to threat intelligence signatures. Use network monitoring to identify connections to known C2 servers or suspicious domains. Employ web filtering and endpoint protection to block drive-by downloads and ransomware payloads. Regularly update detection rules to account for new variants and code reuse.
